RecordingSubtitles.dahl-01:
This is Director Jeremiah Dahl of Habitation Red's Rho Laboratory.
We've completed our expedition across the transit line to Habitation Yellow and we've taken all the notes and samples we possibly could have for research.
It's the opinion of the entire staff and [DISTORTION] that the substructure must be condemned and sealed for the sake of all mankind, or whatever's left.
If you've managed to make it to this landing and are hearing me, heed my words. Do not, under any circumstances, break the seal to this structure. We can only fathom in the smallest of fractions what might lie beyond this gate, and it may doom our entire species, or even world.[RS]
RecordingSubtitles.dahl-radio-01:
[STATIC]ember, 2033. This is Dahl…
Seismographic readings indicate activity that coincides with the start of the PCR experiment in substructure 17's PCR bay.
I don't know the extent of the damage yet, and am waiting to hear from our associates in substructure 09. We shall see what the case is soon.[RS]
RecordingSubtitles.dahl-radio-02:
28th of December, 2033: The worst has occurred, just as I feared it.
Substructure 17's PCR experiment has experienced a catastrophic failure. All of my colleagues who were working on the experiment were killed or have succumbed to feedback syndrome.
It is apparent that the Local Authority was withholding the true volume of Cognitivol they had as well.
So many unnecessary deaths… My God Simon…what have you done?!
We are making an attempt to contact Rho now for some guidance. The situation is deteriorating rapidly.[RS]
RecordingSubtitles.dahl-radio-03:
27th of March, 2034: Through the great guidance of Rho, we've made several successful pilgrimages to SB17 in the last few months.
The conditions of substructure 17 are dire and I have already written it off as a loss.
We are in the process of constructing a machine that will keep the Delta periphery rift shut and stable.
However, there is still the matter of the entity at the bottom. It remains dormant for now, but I worry our presence may rouse it from its sleep.
This last trip will allow us to collect the information we need to form our own escape plan.[RS]
RecordingSubtitles.dahl-radio-04:
Rho... please hear us. As we call your name, please, grant us relief.
Help me. Help me keep my people safe...[RS]
RecordingSubtitles.dahl-radio-05:
11th of June, 2034… I… I don’t know how much longer we can keep this up.
We're backed into a corner by the utter insanity of the superstructure at this point. Substructure 17 was sealed off in April, but we have no contingency for that damned thing at the bottom.
Rho's own altars will only be effective at warding it away should it come after us, but it would only delay the inevitable.
We haven’t done enough. I… haven’t done enough. It is too cruel.
My scientists have fed the memories of their loved ones to Rho in exchange for rotisserie chicken from another world.
We all salivate like mutts when the smoke of ceremonial candles fills the air around us. We have risked our lives daily for years and lost more than we could have ever imagined…
All for what?[RS]
RecordingSubtitles.dahl-radio-06:
4th of August, 2034. We finally have a plan in place. We only have the mettle left to fulfil this one last task.
The plan is our last act of kindness to this world that raised us. We shall sabotage Substructure 12's coolant manufacturing to freeze the cavern before leaving for Rho.
Much like our ancestors in ancient times, we shall leave our cave and embrace a new and terrifying prospect so that we may better ourselves in the future. We are on schedule to complete construction in 266 days.[RS]
RecordingSubtitles.dahl-radio-07:
13th of August. I don’t have any other options. Rho has agreed to take in everyone, but everything must be done through a trade, as always.
The cost to save the remainder of the human species is for one of us to stay behind and act as a living, breathing reminder to Rho’s greatness.
They will lose everything that makes them human and I… I am the only one that can do that.
[Long breath in and out] Construction on the PCR modifications will be completed in 257 days… in 257 days this chapter will finally come to an end…
I leave this record as proof of my life and perseverance as a scientist and human being. There’s no more time for introspection. There’s work to be done.[RS]
